subject: Accelerator package: 18-month tiered prepay for Helios AI
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking a look — Helios is moving fast after our seed close and we're evaluating prepay packages to lock predictable unit economics while we iterate on inference-heavy features. We have a rough 18-month plan and would like something founder-friendly that lets us start small and ramp without huge penalties. Key asks: 1) an 18-month option with a ramped minimum (lower commitment in first 6 months), 2) upfront credits to offset early spend, and 3) a predictable discount tied to term length.

We expect ~30–70M tokens/month in steady state after 9–12 months; year-1 will be well below that. Our CFO (James Park) is on copy for budget questions.

Attached a quick intro deck and an initial usage estimate. Would love a sketch commercial so we can take to the board / accelerator.

[Attachment: helios_intro_deck.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: helios_usage_estimates.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
CEO, Helios AI
https://helios.ai
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Hi Alice — great to meet you and congrats on the seed close. High level sketch below; I copied Marissa (commercial) and Laura (customer success) to help refine the numbers and run an operational feasibility check.

Proposal sketch (18-month, founder-friendly starter):
- Term: 18 months
- Upfront prepay: $120,000 USD applied as platform credits at contract start
- Term discount: 12% off published hosted rates (applied after credits)
- Ramped minimums: months 1–3 = 25% of monthly baseline; months 4–9 = 50%; months 10–18 = 100%
- Additional one-time onboarding credit: $10,000 to help with evals and benchmark runs
- Credits expire against usage over first 12 months, then convert to a 6-month tail at 50% value if unused (we can discuss carry-forward language)

Next steps: Marissa will turn this into a commercial term sheet with a couple of alternate structures (12-month and full annual prepay) and we'll include an initial SOW for ramp checkpoints. If it looks good, we can prepare a DocuSign term sheet and a PO path for your finance team.

Attaching an initial proposal draft for your review.

[Attachment: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Park <james@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Thanks Rishi — super helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side (James and I discussed):

1) Credit expiry: can credits be applied across months as usage accrues, or do they need to be consumed in a contiguous window?
2) Early termination: what is the refund policy if we fail to use the prepaid amount within 18 months (accelerator economics can change quickly)?
3) SLA and regional/compliance: we need confirmation that data for Helios AI remains in us-east for the contract and that audit logs for usage are available for quarterly reviews.

We are exploring a slight tweak: lower the year-1 committed floor (maybe 12 months at lower baseline) and push the ramp to be more backloaded since our product will launch mid-Q3. Can you share a sample amortization / monthly billing projection so we can show it to our CFO?

Attached a cleaner usage projection.

[Attachment: helios_usage_estimates.xlsx (updated)]

Best,
Alice
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Hi Alice — Marissa here with the commercial details. Thanks for the context; below are two concrete offers you can take to finance/board:

Option A — 18-month tiered prepay (recommended)
- Prepay amount: $120k upfront
- Effective term discount: 12% off list for all consumed units after credits
- Credits: $20k onboarding credits applied to first 6 months of usage; remaining $100k applied as prepay balance
- Ramped minimums (billing baseline): months 1–3 = 20% of the average monthly allocation; months 4–9 = 50%; months 10–18 = 100%
- Early termination: pro-rata refund of unused prepaid balance after 90-day winding period, subject to a $5k administrative fee and reconciliation of usage-based discounts

Option B — 12-month accelerated prepay (if you want shorter term)
- Prepay: $85k upfront
- Discount: 8% off list
- Credits: $10k onboarding credit
- Fixed minimum: months 1–12 billed at 60% baseline with monthly true-ups
- Early termination: no refund (shorter term, lower discount)

Pricing mechanics & examples included in attached sheet (how credits apply month-to-month and sample amortization across 18 months). We can also include a clause that allows one protected month of credit carry-forward into a 6-month tail at 50% value (one-time concession for startups in accelerators).

Operational notes: Laura, our CSM, will run a short tech onboarding plan and schedule a perf benchmark. We’ll also confirm regional residency and provide an audit logs export cadence for quarterly reviews.

If this looks reasonable we’ll draft a term sheet and a DocuSign link for approvals; otherwise tell us which parts to iterate on.

[Attachment: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (updated, includes amortization table)]

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Internal legal/commercial notes for the term sheet: please include the following minimum language for accelerator deals:
- Refund mechanics: define a 90-day reconciliation window and admin fee (we proposed $5k — OK for this size).
- Credit expiry: credits applied first to active usage, any remaining credits may be carried forward once at 50% value into a 6-month tail; explicit carve-outs for promotional credits.
- Data residency: Helios data must reside in us-east region; add a Service Location clause.
- Audit rights: quarterly usage reports and one audit per 12 months with reasonable notice.
- Termination for convenience: allow for pro-rata refunds only after the reconciliation window; exclude refunds on promotional onboarding credits.

I created a DocuSign term URL with the current draft for review: https://docusign.example/helios-term-v1

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Park <james@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Prepay options for early growth team

Appreciate the quick turnaround and detail — this is very helpful. A few follow-ups from James (CFO):

- We prefer Option A but would ask that the year-1 minimum be softened to a 12-month floor at 30% baseline, with the remainder of the ramp backloaded to months 13–18. That protects our runway while showing commitment.
- Can you confirm the exact amortized monthly charge under Option A after the $20k onboarding credit so James can model the burn?
- The DocuSign link works for review; we’ll route to legal after final commercials.

If you can send an amortization table (monthly charge column) reflecting the 12-month softened floor, we can share with our board this week and aim to sign before the accelerator deadline.

On the appointment side — we’d like a short call next week to lock this down.

Thanks,
Alice

Alice / James — appreciate the guidance. We can revise Option A to match the softened year-1 floor:
- Modified ramp: months 1–12 = 30% baseline, months 13–15 = 60%, months 16–18 = 100% (amortization table attached).
- Monthly amortized charge after credits (example): months 1–12 = $3,500/mo, months 13–15 = $7,000/mo, months 16–18 = $11,500/mo (these are illustrative and depend on final token consumption).
- All other commercial/legal items per Sergio's draft are acceptable; we'll mark the $20k onboarding credits as non-refundable promotional credits.

Next steps: Marissa will push a revised term sheet into the DocuSign link and Laura will propose a 2-week kickoff plan (benchmark + performance targets). If Helios confirms by Friday we can get signatures and the onboarding credit applied immediately on contract execution.

Proposed call: Thursday 2026-05-27 10:00 PT — 20 minutes to align. Does that work?

Best,
Rishi
